contracts.scope: Unprivileged real CLI with an inaccessible isolated configuration directory. Validates explicit access-error refusal in validate and reset, unchanged bytes and recovery. This is not native package transactions evidence. Does not establish all configuration error handling, symlink policy or concurrent access semantics; broader gaps remain.

Covers replacement of pre-existing backup symlinks and hard links without changing their targets, exact backup bytes and mode 0600. This is not native package transactions evidence. Does not claim parent-directory race safety, concurrent reset/write or crash recovery; broader gaps remain.

Unprivileged daemon-disabled real CLI with isolated configuration. Covers reset --yes, absent configuration, original-byte backup and refusal/recovery when a directory obstructs backup creation. This is not native package transactions evidence. Does not cover interactive confirmation, concurrent reset/write, backup symlinks, disk exhaustion or every default field; broader gaps remain.

Real daemon-disabled CLI with isolated configuration and unprivileged execution. Covers six writable settings, exact read-back, invalid writes, unchanged bytes and subsequent validation. This is not native package transactions evidence. Does not cover concurrent writers, privileged configuration inheritance, reset backups, filesystem failures or all accepted and rejected value boundaries; broader gaps remain.
